milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The grass plants (minecraft:grass) are clustered at spawn-relative positions (2,0,3), (3,0,2), (1,0,4), (4,0,3), (2,0,5), (3,0,4) with center at (3,0,4). max_distance=10 ensures the player has navigated toward the grass cluster (tighter than default 16 since the scene is only ~20 blocks across), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the plants rather than just passing by.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The blue orchids are at spawn-relative (6,0,7), (7,0,8), (5,0,9) with center at (6,0,8). max_distance=10 means the player needs to have navigated toward the orchid cluster (further from spawn than grass), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at the flowers. This naturally follows finding grass since the orchids are further along the forward-right path.

Uses inventory_has because mining orange_concrete_powder drops the item into the player's inventory. This is the most reliable and direct check for a mine task — it confirms the player actually broke the block and collected the drop. The player has a diamond pickaxe provided, though concrete powder can be mined with any tool or bare hands.
